issues.reason: Compound concepts states the modifier genus is exposed only for an adjectival property predicable of the referent and that a NOUN modifier is never exposed, so (Inheritance mideast_peace_plan mideast) asserts the false, ill-typed claim that a peace plan is a mideast.

The proper-noun exclusion cited governs a multi-word NAME occupying the whole NP (kestrel_river), not a capitalized noun used attributively inside an indefinite common-noun compound; with no licensed head for 'a plan concerning the Mideast', the fusion is graceful improvisation in gap territory and (Inheritance mideast_peace_plan plan) is true and well-typed.

'overnight' falls outside the morning/afternoon/evening/night day-part inventory (the reviewer's own gap), and (Time e night) is true of an overnight event and uses a licensed day-part symbol — the calibration line refutes an objection to true, well-typed improvisation in gap territory.

The containment is traceable to the words 'West Bank' modifying 'outposts' — the same licence as 'in coastal Calderwick' -> (LocatedIn sk_zone_1 calderwick) and the stacked-place (LocatedIn thornmere calderwick) — and the atom is true, so this is a coverage gap in attributive-proper-noun modification, not an unstated inference like the wick/lantern PartOf case.

gaps_confirmed: a proper noun used as an ATTRIBUTIVE modifier of a common-noun compound ('West Bank settlement outposts', 'Mideast peace plan') — Names & casing covers only a capitalized modifier joining a name and a lowercase adjective carving out a sub-region

an episodic, specific bare-plural argument ('ISRAELI soldiers ... knocked down empty mobile homes and water towers') — the determiner rule routes bare plurals to the generic kind and reserves group witnesses for definite/demonstrative/possessed plurals
'overnight' as a temporal adjunct — neither a listed day-part nor a listed deictic constant
new_gaps: a proper-noun + past-participle pre-modifier ('a US-backed plan') has no stated route: the laminated-worktop rule makes a modifying participle an adjective, while the reduced-relative rule makes it an event, and neither wording addresses the incorporated proper-noun agent

after removing the false modifier genus, the proper noun 'Mideast' has no symbol at all, so its mandatory (Name …) fact has nowhere to attach — the fused-modifier route silently drops a proper noun's Name
repair_summary: Removed (: plan_mideast (Inheritance mideast_peace_plan mideast) (STV 1.0 0.99)); no other line changed.
notes: AsPartOf reads as the licensed multi-word preposition-named oblique, and the two knock_down events, the empty/tiny distribution rules and the West Bank LocatedIn all stand.
